+/**

+/**
+ * @brief 在填充 0xA5 的脏内存上测试未激活 optional<std::string> 的拷贝与移动构造
+ * @return 无返回值；若未打补丁将触发 std::string::_M_construct SIGSEGV 崩溃
+ */
+static void test_unengaged_optional_on_dirty_memory(void)
+{
+    using OptString = eprosima::fastcdr::optional<std::string>;
+    alignas(OptString) unsigned char dirty_src[sizeof(OptString)];
+    alignas(OptString) unsigned char dirty_copy[sizeof(OptString)];
+    alignas(OptString) unsigned char dirty_move[sizeof(OptString)];
+
+    /* 用 0xA5 填充底层缓冲区，模拟未初始化的栈/堆脏内存 */
+    std::memset(dirty_src, 0xA5, sizeof(dirty_src));
+    std::memset(dirty_copy, 0xA5, sizeof(dirty_copy));
+    std::memset(dirty_move, 0xA5, sizeof(dirty_move));
+
+    /* 在脏内存上默认构造未激活 (engaged_ == false) 的 optional<std::string> */
+    OptString* src_ptr = new (dirty_src) OptString();
+    assert(!src_ptr->has_value());
+
+    /* 执行拷贝构造与移动构造，验证 if (val.storage_.engaged_) 守卫阻止野指针解引用 */
+    OptString* copy_ptr = new (dirty_copy) OptString(*src_ptr);
+    assert(!copy_ptr->has_value());
+
+    OptString* move_ptr = new (dirty_move) OptString(std::move(*src_ptr));
+    assert(!move_ptr->has_value());
+
+    move_ptr->~OptString();
+    copy_ptr->~OptString();
+    src_ptr->~OptString();
+    std::printf("PASS: test_unengaged_optional_on_dirty_memory\n");
+}
+
+/**
+ * @brief 验证已激活长字符串 (>32字节，突破SSO) optional<std::string> 的拷贝与移动构造
+ * @return 无返回值；任一断言失败时终止进程
+ */
+static void test_engaged_optional_copy_and_move(void)
+{
+    using OptString = eprosima::fastcdr::optional<std::string>;
+    const std::string long_payload =
+        "AISOC_FASTCDR_OPTIONAL_ENGAGED_HEAP_STRING_PAYLOAD_20261105_VERIFY";
+
+    /* 构造已激活的 optional<std::string> 并校验拷贝构造内容完整 */
+    OptString original(long_payload);
+    assert(original.has_value());
+    assert(original.value() == long_payload);
+
+    OptString copied(original);
+    assert(copied.has_value());
+    assert(copied.value() == long_payload);
+
+    /* 执行移动构造并校验目标对象持有完整长字符串内容 */
+    OptString moved(std::move(copied));
+    assert(moved.has_value());
+    assert(moved.value() == long_payload);
+    std::printf("PASS: test_engaged_optional_copy_and_move\n");
+}
+
+/**
+ * @brief 验证 Fast-DDS DomainParticipant/Publisher/Subscriber 创建及内置主题发现无 SIGSEGV
+ * @return 无返回值；任一断言失败时终止进程
+ */
+static void test_dds_builtin_topic_participant_and_pub_startup(void)
+{
+    aisoc_dds_participant_t* part = nullptr;
+    const aisoc_dds_participant_config_t part_cfg = {
+        0U, "Twin52OptionalGuardTestParticipant", nullptr
+    };
+    assert(aisoc_dds_participant_create(&part_cfg, &part) == AISOC_DDS_OK);
+    assert(part != nullptr);
+
+    /* 创建 Publisher 与 Subscriber，触发 Fast-DDS PublicationBuiltinTopicData 拷贝/移动路径 */
+    aisoc_dds_publisher_t* pub = nullptr;
+    const aisoc_dds_publisher_config_t pub_cfg = {
+        AISOC_TOPIC_RAW_TEMP, AISOC_DDS_QOS_RELIABLE_VOLATILE
+    };
+    assert(aisoc_dds_publisher_create(part, &pub_cfg, &pub) == AISOC_DDS_OK);
+
+    aisoc_dds_subscriber_t* sub = nullptr;
+    aisoc_dds_subscriber_config_t sub_cfg = {};
+    sub_cfg.topic_name = AISOC_TOPIC_RAW_TEMP;
+    sub_cfg.qos_profile = AISOC_DDS_QOS_RELIABLE_VOLATILE;
+    assert(aisoc_dds_subscriber_create(part, &sub_cfg, &sub) == AISOC_DDS_OK);
+
+    /* 发布并接收一帧温度遥测样本，确认端到端 DDS 通路正常 */
+    aisoc_raw_temp_t tx_sample = { 1U, 60000, AISOC_SENSOR_OK, 2048U, 100U, 200ULL, 1U };
+    assert(aisoc_dds_publish_raw_temp(pub, &tx_sample) == AISOC_DDS_OK);
+
+    aisoc_raw_temp_t rx_sample = {};
+    assert(aisoc_dds_wait_for_raw_temp(sub, 1000U, &rx_sample) == AISOC_DDS_OK);
+    assert(rx_sample.temperature_millic == 60000);
+
+    assert(aisoc_dds_subscriber_destroy(sub) == AISOC_DDS_OK);
+    assert(aisoc_dds_publisher_destroy(pub) == AISOC_DDS_OK);
+    assert(aisoc_dds_participant_destroy(part) == AISOC_DDS_OK);
+    std::printf("PASS: test_dds_builtin_topic_participant_and_pub_startup\n");
+}

+ * @brief TWIN-52 回归测试主入口
+ * @return int 全部测试通过返回 0
+ */

+    std::printf("Running Fast-CDR optional<T> & Fast-DDS Startup Regression Tests...\n");
+    test_unengaged_optional_on_dirty_memory();
+    test_engaged_optional_copy_and_move();
+    test_dds_builtin_topic_participant_and_pub_startup();

+    return 0;
+}
